== dist/operations/liquidityManager/wrap.js lines 40-60
    const nativeUnderlying = isNativeToken(underlying);
    let approvalTransactionHash;
    if (!nativeUnderlying) {
        const currentAllowance = ensureBigintLike(await reader.readContract({
            address: underlying,
            abi: ERC20_ABI,
            functionName: "allowance",
            args: [account, managerAddress],
        }), "allowance");
        if (currentAllowance < normalizedAmount) {
            const approvalHash = await writeProvider.writeContract({
                address: underlying,
                abi: ERC20_ABI,
                functionName: "approve",
                args: [managerAddress, normalizedAmount],
                ...txOverrides,
            });
            const approvalReceipt = await receipt.waitForTransactionReceipt({
                hash: approvalHash,
            });
            approvalTransactionHash = approvalReceipt.transactionHash;

== dist/constants.js lines 1-30
/**
 * Protocol-fixed constants and internal SDK defaults.
 * @remarks
 * Protocol constants are exported from the public API. Internal defaults remain unexported unless
 * callers need them for validation.
 * The `DEFAULT_*` values are internal tuning defaults, overridable via optional parameters.
 */
/** Height of the aggregation tree (number of levels). */
export const AGGREGATION_TREE_HEIGHT = 6;
/** Height of the per-chain transfer tree (number of levels). */
export const TRANSFER_TREE_HEIGHT = 40;
/** Height of the global transfer tree (aggregation + transfer). */
export const GLOBAL_TRANSFER_TREE_HEIGHT = TRANSFER_TREE_HEIGHT + AGGREGATION_TREE_HEIGHT;
/** Number of burn addresses in a batch invoice. */
export const NUM_BATCH_INVOICES = 10;
/** Default max number of events to fetch per indexer request. */
export const DEFAULT_INDEXER_FETCH_LIMIT = 20;
/** Max number of indexer events supported by receive flows. */
export const MAX_INDEXER_FETCH_LIMIT = 100;
/** Default block span used when querying aggregation state (in blocks). */
export const DEFAULT_EVENT_BLOCK_SPAN = 5000n;
/** Default timeout for decider jobs (milliseconds). */
export const DEFAULT_DECIDER_TIMEOUT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
/** Default polling interval for decider job status checks (milliseconds). */
export const DEFAULT_DECIDER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 1_000;
/** Default IC storage tag used when no tag is provided. */
export const DEFAULT_ZSTORAGE_TAG = "v1";
//# sourceMappingURL=constants.js.map
